post.description: expectedRevision is the current global state revision. Ops commands with entityRevision also check the target record revision; sourceRevision protects translation source versions. Idempotency-key reuse with the same command replays one result; reuse with a different command returns 409. Server derives actor/role from the cookie session and must not accept a client actor. Only authorized, validated mutations may enter an atomic transaction.
